belay.2: Bolted stance on a pedestal at the arete, after turning the corner.
belay.3: A good ledge reached after the traverse to the stacked-block pedestal and the corner above it.
belay.4: A perch on a ledge out to the left of the corner.
belay.9: Bolted belay just to the right of a very large flake.
belay.12: A perch on the prow, reached after the pockets and crimps.

belay.9: Chain anchor on the buttress crest.
belay.10: Anchor on the crest, up the right side of the buttress over blocky ground.
